User guide

Keyboard and mouse

Transport

KeyAction
Space (tap)play / pause; a second tap right after pausing returns to the start
Space (hold)play faster, ramping up to 4×; release to return to normal speed
A / Homeback: previous marker, region edge or event edge
D / Endforward: next marker, region edge or event edge
Shift+A / Shift+Djump and drag the region edge along
Shift+Home / Shift+Endthe very start / end of the project
Ctrl+Ljump to a typed timecode (digits fill from the right, Enter jumps)
Lloop the region

Editing

KeyAction
Ssplit at the playhead, or cut out the region
Delete / Backspacedelete
Ctrl+Zundo
Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Yredo
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+Vcopy / paste at the playhead
Ctrl+Ssave
Ctrl+Fsearch the project (↑/↓ choose, Enter jumps, Esc closes)
Mmarker at the playhead (toggle)
I / Oregion start / end at the playhead
Alt+M / Alt+Smute / solo the selected event's track
Enterexpand the selected reel in place; again — open it
Escstep back: close the top window, clear region and selection, collapse, leave the reel

Mouse on the timeline

GestureAction
click the ruler, dragmove the playhead, scrub
drag on empty spaceregion
Ctrl+drag on empty spaceselect events
wheel / Ctrl+wheelscroll / zoom around the mouse
Shift+wheel / Ctrl+Shift+wheelscroll tracks / track height
drag an event (Ctrl — no magnet)move
double-click an eventeffects window
Shift+double-click an eventregion over it
drag a top corner of an eventfade
drag the level lineopacity / gain; double-click — full / 0 dB
drag a transition's edge / its cutresize / roll
double-click a transitiontransition properties
double-click a reelexpand in place / collapse
double-click a morphermorpher editor
drag a track header / its bottom edgereorder / height (right-click resets)
right-click anythingits menu

The status line always shows what the thing under the mouse does.
